epistemic_guardrails: Samsung's Q3 2024 earnings-call script is primary for Samsung's own reported HBM3E production and sales state.
The statement explicitly includes both HBM3E 8-stack and 12-stack products; do not generalize it into an unversioned HBM3E status.
Mass production and generating sales in Q3 2024 do not establish the exact production-onset date and do not prove that 12-stack mass production began in calendar Q2.
The source's separate statement that an important phase in a qualification process was completed is not a named-customer or completed-platform qualification state and is outside this fragment.
The readable JSON representation preserves claim-relevant text actually read from the upstream PDF; it is content_verified and must not be described as raw PDF materialization.
Grounding creates EvidenceFragments only; Reality/Outcome promotion remains a separate admitted step.
